title: Bag of Bricks - Bright Orange 35
descriptionHtml:
Bright Orange — colour 35

High-intensity orange that behaves almost like a highlighter. Against greys and blues it pops hard, which makes it ideal for accents, flames and bold graphic work.

Works well with: Orange 24, Spring Yellow 04, Dark Grey 31

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Bright Orange bricks (colour 35) for Memobrick mosaics. A high-intensity orange that pops hard against blues and greys.
